intended_use: Decision-support signal for resume intelligence workflows.
training_data_summary: Baseline dataset from local data/resume_dataset.csv. Full resume text is not stored in registry metadata.

caveats: Very high validation accuracy may indicate an easy dataset, small validation split, overfitting, or data leakage. Review evaluation setup.

known_limitations: May show low confidence on real resumes
May be sensitive to resume wording and formatting
Validation accuracy should be investigated if unusually high
privacy_notes: Full resume text should not be stored in model registry metadata
PII should be masked in display/export workflows
responsible_ai_notes: Use combined fit signals and human review
